description: Loan applicant (or their family) controls the lending bank (P3 Rule 10)
Control of the lending bank runs through a pyramid of depth >= 3
Subject or a company their family controls invoiced without being paid (P3 Eq. 2)
Subject account made >= 5 transfers of 1000-3000 totalling >= 9000 in one day
Subject account sits on a circular chain of transfers
PEP account credited from a high-risk jurisdiction
Reported transfer is just under the 10000 reporting threshold
Subject account credited by an entity not in the company or person register
Subject has a criminal record (weak prior)
GNN account classifier probability for the subject's accounts
Subject account is credited by or pays at least 10 distinct accounts (fan-in / fan-out)
